conformance.bend: Base
./state.bend as S
./core.bend as C
./fips.bend as F
./list_proofs.bend as L
./padding_proof.bend as Padding

law count_acc:
  for +xs: List<&2, U32>
  for +acc: Nat
  {C.byte_count(xs, acc) == Nat.add(List.length(&2, U32, xs), acc) : Nat}

law octets_correct:
  for +width: Nat
  for +n: Nat
  for +acc: List<&2, U32>
  {C.length_octets(width, n, acc) == List.append(&2, U32, F.octets(width, n), acc) : List<&2, U32>}

law words_acc:
  for +bytes: List<&2, U32>
  for +acc: List<&2, U32>
  {C.words_go(bytes, acc) == List.reverse.go(&2, U32, acc, F.words(bytes)) : List<&2, U32>}

law nth_correct:
  for xs: List<&2, U32>
  for n: Nat
  {C.get(xs, n) == F.nth(xs, n) : U32}

law extension_correct:
  for +n: Nat
  for +hs: List<&2, U32>
  {C.expand(n, hs) == F.extension(n, hs) : List<&2, U32>}

law schedule_correct:
  for +extra: Nat
  for +block: List<&2, U32>
  {C.schedule(extra, block) == F.schedule(extra, block) : List<&2, U32>}

law schedules_acc:
  for +ws: List<&2, U32>
  for +extra: Nat
  for +acc: List<&2, List<&2, U32>>
  {C.schedules_go(ws, extra, acc) == List.reverse.go(&2, List<&2, U32>, acc, F.schedules(ws, extra)) : List<&2, List<&2, U32>>}

law schedules_correct:
  for ws: List<&2, U32>
  for extra: Nat
  {C.schedules(ws, extra) == F.schedules(ws, extra) : List<&2, List<&2, U32>>}

law prepare_correct:
  for +bytes: List<&2, U32>
  for +extra: Nat
  {C.prepare(bytes, extra) == F.prepare(bytes, extra) : List<&2, List<&2, U32>>}

law step_correct:
  for s: S.State
  for k: U32
  for w: U32
  {C.step(s, k, w) == F.step(s, k, w) : S.State}

law rounds_correct:
  for +ks: List<&2, U32>
  for +ws: List<&2, U32>
  for +s: S.State
  {C.rounds(ks, ws, s) == F.rounds(ks, ws)(s) : S.State}

law feedforward_correct:
  for x: S.State
  for y: S.State
  {C.feedforward(x, y) == F.feedforward(x, y) : S.State}

law compression_correct:
  for +ws: List<&2, U32>
  for +ks: List<&2, U32>
  for +s: S.State
  {C.compress(ws, ks, s) == F.compress(ws, ks, s) : S.State}

law blocks_correct:
  for +ws: List<&2, List<&2, U32>>
  for +ks: List<&2, U32>
  for +s: S.State
  {C.blocks(ws, ks, s) == F.blocks(ws, ks)(s) : S.State}

law hash_correct:
  for +bytes: List<&2, U32>
  for +extra: Nat
  for +ks: List<&2, U32>
  {C.hash(bytes, extra, ks) == F.hash(bytes, extra, ks) : List<&2, U32>}
list_proofs.bend:
law append_assoc:
  for -A: Data
  for xs: List<&2, A>
  for ys: List<&2, A>
  for zs: List<&2, A>
  {List.append(&2, A, List.append(&2, A, xs, ys), zs)
    == List.append(&2, A, xs, List.append(&2, A, ys, zs)) : List<&2, A>}

law reverse_twice:
  for -A: Data
  for xs: List<&2, A>
  for acc: List<&2, A>
  for ys: List<&2, A>
  {List.reverse.go(&2, A, List.reverse.go(&2, A, xs, acc), ys)
    == List.reverse.go(&2, A, acc, List.append(&2, A, xs, ys)) : List<&2, A>}

law reverse_append:
  for -A: Data
  for xs: List<&2, A>
  for ys: List<&2, A>
  {List.reverse.go(&2, A, List.reverse(&2, A, xs), ys)
    == List.append(&2, A, xs, ys) : List<&2, A>}

law add_succ:
  for n: Nat
  for m: Nat
  {Nat.add(n, 1n+m) == 1n+Nat.add(n, m) : Nat}

law append_assoc_reverse:
  for -A: Data
  for +xs: List<&2, A>
  for +ys: List<&2, A>
  for +zs: List<&2, A>
  {List.append(&2, A, xs, List.append(&2, A, ys, zs))
    == List.append(&2, A, List.append(&2, A, xs, ys), zs) : List<&2, A>}
